evidence_gaps: Fresh-within-two-hours sanitized runtime forensics are unavailable; evidence.json reports MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS.
No cost-complete transaction-level Solana outcomes covering base fees, priority fees, platform fees, price impact, slippage, rent paid/reclaimed and failed-transaction costs.
No EVM attempted-transaction reconciliation covering reverted transactions, receipt timeouts, replacement transactions, actual gas, MEV/inclusion decay and retained user net after platform fees.
No strategy-version and source-commit isolated out-of-sample net P&L series by chain, settlement asset and deployed capital.
No opportunity funnel separating no-market-edge skips, strategy rejections, liquidity/sellability failures, simulation failures, infrastructure failures and signed execution failures.
No drawdown, tail-loss, capital-at-risk, holding-time or confidence-interval evidence sufficient for promotion.

Before any promotion: require fresh runtime provenance, complete cost attribution, chain-specific out-of-sample shadow results, failure reconciliation, positive money-weighted retained net P&L with a positive lower confidence bound, acceptable drawdown, and confirmation that all execution protections remained enabled.

proposals.downside_risk: Schema migration and stricter accounting will reduce apparent sample size and may invalidate historical windows lacking cost provenance.

evidence.detail: Window schema has no chain, settlement asset, notional, gas/priority fee, price-impact or capital-exposure dimensions.
Default net_profit is gross_profit minus gross_loss, fees and slippage only.
Metrics sum window monetary values directly, allowing unlike native units or notionals to be combined.
Promotion candidacy uses aggregated net and a profit factor derived from gross profit/loss rather than fully cost-adjusted outcomes.

proposals.expected_effect: Prevents false promotion from unit mixing or incomplete costs and makes evaluation reflect money-weighted retained net P&L.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 closed shadow outcomes and 10 independent windows per strategy-chain-settlement-asset cohort, with complete cost fields and no cross-asset summation.
proposals.rationale: Promotion evidence must remain chain and currency coherent and include every executable cost. Otherwise SOL, ETH and other native amounts, or differently sized trades, can produce misleading aggregate results.
proposals.shadow_test: In Strategy Lab only, replay identical windows under chain-and-asset partitions with observed notional, DEX/platform fees, slippage, price impact, gas or priority fees, rent treatment and failure costs. Stop and mark data unusable if any monetary row lacks chain, asset, notional or cost provenance; reject the hypothesis if normalized conclusions do not differ materially from current evaluation.
suggested_files: Strategy Lab/SHADOW accounting schema and evaluator only

proposals.downside_risk: Receipt reconciliation and causal classification add operational complexity; unknown outcomes must remain conservatively unresolved rather than guessed.

evidence.detail: Execution failures are stored only as an undifferentiated count.
Successful EVM cycles calculate realised net using the wallet delta and actual receipt gas.
The exception path records REJECTED with blank realised net; a reverted or uncertain broadcast may therefore omit consumed gas and lacks strategy-versus-infrastructure classification.
Canary recording accepts only a boolean execution_failure and free-text reason, limiting causal attribution.

proposals.expected_effect: Captures failure gas and opportunity costs while preventing infrastructure defects from being misdiagnosed as alpha decay.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 attempted executions per chain family, including at least 10 genuine failure cases, with transaction-level reconciliation and retained-net totals.
proposals.rationale: A negative executable signal is a STRATEGY/MARKET loss. RPC failure, stale nonce, reverted transaction, receipt timeout or quote/simulation infrastructure failure is EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure. Both affect retained net economics, but require different remediation and must not be conflated.
proposals.shadow_test: Shadow-reconcile every attempted EVM and Solana execution into MARKET_LOSS, STRATEGY_LOSS, EXECUTION_FAILURE or INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE, attaching transaction status and all irreversible fees. Stop if more than 1% of broadcast attempts remain unclassified after the reconciliation horizon or if any failed on-chain transaction has zero recorded fee cost.
suggested_files: Strategy Lab/SHADOW failure taxonomy and reconciliation adapter only

proposals.downside_risk: More conservative dynamic costs may suppress many signals; this is appropriate when executable edge is not positive.

evidence.detail: Shadow entry and exit network/priority fees use fixed conservative estimates.
Entry validation checks signal age, executable Jupiter round trip and leader-entry deterioration.
Live-oriented architecture separately validates combined quoted price impact and slippage.
Live-oriented architecture exposes base fee, priority tip and platform-fee-equivalent costs.

proposals.expected_effect: Produces a more faithful Solana shadow distribution of retained net P&L and identifies regimes where apparent signal edge is consumed by execution costs.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 200 eligible observations across 14 days and multiple congestion regimes, with at least 30 simulated closed positions and complete entry/exit cost records.
proposals.rationale: Solana profitability is sensitive to time-varying priority fees, route impact, account creation/rent exposure and failed-transaction fees. Fixed shadow fee assumptions may not reproduce executable net economics during congestion.
proposals.shadow_test: For each shadow decision, timestamp fresh forward and reverse quotes and record quoted impact, slippage, estimated compute/base/priority fees, account/rent effects and simulated failure outcome. Compare predicted retained net with a later executable quote. Fail the hypothesis if median net is non-positive, the lower confidence bound is non-positive, or cost underestimation exceeds 20% in more than 5% of observations.
suggested_files: Strategy Lab/SHADOW Solana cost-model adapter only

proposals.downside_risk: Simulation-to-inclusion latency, MEV competition and failed-transaction gas may still eliminate quoted edge.

evidence.detail: Scanner candidates fail closed unless exact quote, source, liquidity, route and whole-route approval fields are explicitly true.
Each user wallet receives a fresh route simulation against a retained-net floor before selection.
Confirmed outcomes use wallet balance change and actual receipt gas for realised net.

proposals.expected_effect: Preserves the strongest existing EVM safety design without asserting that the strategy is profitable.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 independent eligible routes over 14 days, 30 realistically simulated or executed outcomes, and complete attempted-transaction reconciliation.
proposals.rationale: The execution architecture appropriately requires fresh, wallet-specific, atomic executable edge and does not force trades. It should remain unchanged pending fresh outcome evidence, subject to failure-cost accounting improvements.
proposals.shadow_test: Continue shadow measurement of quote-to-simulation-to-inclusion decay using all DEX fees, impact, slippage, gas bids, failed-attempt gas and platform fees. Stop the cohort if cost-complete net P&L is non-positive or the 95% lower confidence bound on net per unit capital is non-positive.
suggested_files: Strategy Lab/SHADOW EVM execution-decay study only

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote any strategy based on current repository architecture or raw win rate.
rejected_ideas.reason: There is no fresh runtime evidence, and win count does not establish durable money-weighted net P&L.

rejected_ideas.idea: Relax liquidity, sellability, simulation, price-impact or positive-edge gates to increase trade frequency.
rejected_ideas.reason: Frequency without positive executable edge increases adverse selection and cost exposure.

rejected_ideas.idea: Treat all negative outcomes as strategy losses.
rejected_ideas.reason: Execution and infrastructure failures have distinct causes and remediation, although their irreversible fees must still reduce net P&L.

rejected_ideas.idea: Combine native-chain P&L values into one aggregate without valuation and notional normalization.
rejected_ideas.reason: Unlike units and capital exposures make the result economically invalid.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The repository contains strong fail-closed quoting, simulation, liquidity, sellability and positive-edge controls, but current evaluation can overstate durable money-weighted net performance: Strategy Lab can aggregate incomparable chain-native amounts, omits explicit gas, price-impact and failure-cost fields, and does not distinguish STRATEGY/MARKET losses from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures. EVM failed broadcasts can also omit consumed gas from realised P&L. Solana shadow accounting relies partly on fixed fee estimates rather than observed priority-fee distributions. Runtime forensics are unavailable, so no profitability, CANARY-readiness or LIVE-readiness claim is made.
